PROGRAM zreg_screen_invisible.
DATA gv_counter TYPE i VALUE 1.
MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'SEC'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
    IF screen-group1 = 'OFF'.
      screen-active = '0'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.
